title: 본문4
source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 5 READING 본문 — 본문4
body_text: The final stop of our tour today is Muswell Hill. Can’t see any street artworks? Well, look down and look closely. Do you see the little chewing gum paintings? They are by the artist Ben Wilson. Wilson is well known for painting pictures on gum that people drop on the street. His gum paintings often carry personal messages from people (that) he meets on the street. For example, the one over here is a happy birthday wish for a loved one. Wilson’s gum paintings are tiny, but they give great pleasure to many people.
